show.description: After faking his disappearance from the Chandra Vamsha army, the legendary archer Arjuna lives in disguise as a humble servant to fulfill his dying guru’s last wish , protecting his guru’s daughter and granddaughter. But when greed, betrayal, and deadly warriors threaten to destroy the Gurukul, Arjuna must decide whether to remain hidden… or rise.
